generation.scope: Every finite central-cut window with an integral ordinary nodal quartic or nodal quartic double quadric is classified over its polarized center by the eight Kummer lifts of primitive Brauer classes. This includes exceptional automorphisms and gives the exact period by their action. All such centers have thirty nodes, twenty of type (1,3), without assuming their component, index or reduced markings.

open_mathematics: Analyze the realizability and deformation of the nodal central charts and the remaining non-nodal or noncentral finite asymmetric windows.
